business: A fictional clinical-stage company with one candidate and future funding needs.
event: A product milestone may change the economics; this toy example does not model a clinical probability.
resolution_rule: No real event is forecast. Replace with a precise endpoint, deadline and primary-source rule for actual research.
horizon: Illustrative present-value scenarios; no forecast holding period.
model_limits: Two favorable assumptions and one unfavorable state are sensitivity cases, not mutually exclusive measured probabilities. Model omits risk-premium differences and detailed clinical transitions. No calibrated forecast or cost-adjusted decision margin.

evidence.title: Fictional launch planning assumption
evidence.claim: Launch timing used in both favorable scenarios is assumed, not an issuer fact.

evidence.title: Fictional downside assumption
evidence.claim: A downside state has assumed equity value of 2 billion, not a guaranteed cash floor.

counterevidence: Clinical milestones do not establish regulatory approval or commercial demand.
unknowns: No evidence-based event probability is available.
Actual launch timing, financing terms and risk premia are not supplied.
invalidation_conditions: Withdrawn launch-timing support invalidates dependent favorable values.
Changed financing terms require both cash and diluted share count to be reviewed.

scenarios.label: Favorable economics A
scenarios.assumptions: Fictional equity bridge in whole USD and whole shares; operating value is already present value. No additional cash or claims in this toy case.
